name: Distinguished Service Award (miniature medal body)
size_basis: Raster proportion: the ribbon in images/mini_medals/mcchord/m_distin01.webp is 0.625 in wide (ribbon measured 50 px in the source raster) (miniature 5/8 in; coordination chat citing DoDM 1348.33; CAPR 39-3 gives no medal dimensions); the medal body is measured at 50 x 55 source px = 0.625 x 0.688 in at that scale. Absolute size is an estimate.

ribbon_ref.note: medal body only; the ribbon asset supplies the stripes and devices. ribbon_attach is where the ribbon meets the suspension loop.

fit.metric: silhouette IoU vs source alpha at source resolution
fit.note: Source medal is ~35-50 px across; engraving and lettering are not resolved. Vector = smoothed silhouette (true circle/ellipse where the outline is one) + mid tone + at most dark and light tone layers (sampled k-means colours) + rim.
